facts.fact: INSEED states that ANATS, a public establishment under the ministry in charge of security created by Ordonnance 001/PR/2016, is in charge of organising and keeping the civil status system, and that article 23 of Ordonnance 002/PR/2020 of 14 February 2020 gives it the organisation and keeping of the civil status file and its archives.
facts.system: système d'état civil (fichier de l'état civil)

facts.fact: INSEED states that a national strategic plan for improving civil status covers 2018-2022, its seventh axis being the progressive computerisation and lasting financing of civil status; no costing or budget is given.

INSEED describes the civil status centre entering a birth in the register of birth declarations from the second leaf of the maternity's paper birth bulletin, quotes UNICEF's representative (10 August 2022) that centres frequently run out of birth-act registers, lists weak computerisation of registration centres among the eight priority problems of the 2017 assessment, and still recommends computerising the system.
